opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 900.] Motion of petitioner Ruth Freedman for leave to proceed further herein informa pau-peris granted. Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Alex Reisman, Esquire, of San Francisco, Cal., be appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner Ruth Freedman in this case.
